commit_message:
feat(nvidia_nim): auto-discover NVIDIA Build catalog endpoint and validate models (#3953)

- endpoint_url now optional with default https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1
  (NVIDIA Build catalog); empty value auto-targets the catalog.
- New optional api_key credential (secret-input) for cloud catalog auth.
- validate_credentials: normalize endpoint, soft-check the model against
  the OpenAI-compatible /models list with typo suggestions, and keep the
  inherited ping as the authoritative key/access check. Custom NIM
  endpoints without /models fall back gracefully.
- Add api_key field, README auto-discovery section, tests with mocked HTTP,
  manifest 0.0.12, pytest dev dep + lockfile.

Co-authored-by: hpiclaranet <hpiclaranet@users.noreply.github.com>
